faqs.q: How do reviews affect ranking in Ottawa?
faqs.a: Reviews are both a ranking signal and a conversion driver. In Ottawa, where patients compare several dentists, consistent, recent and genuine reviews often tip the decision.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Ottawa at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: Do neighbourhood pages actually help in Ottawa?
faqs.a: Yes. Patients in Ottawa often search with a neighbourhood or district attached, from Barrhaven to Orleans, so distinct pages for the areas you serve help you appear for those more specific searches.

faqs.a: A clear description of your treatment, the areas you cover, how to book a appointment, what it costs, and the proof patients look for before they make contact.
